story: Sophie is in the classroom. Sophie has a fish in a small, round bowl. The fish is red and orange. Sophie puts the bowl on the table. [emotion:QT/surprised] But the bowl is not there! [emotion:QT/afraid] Sophie looks under the chair. Sophie looks behind the big blue box. Sophie asks her friend Mia for help. Mia and Sophie look together. [emotion:QT/happy] They find the round bowl on the teacher's desk. The red and orange fish is swimming and splashing. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie and Mia are happy. [gesture:clapping] The teacher is watching and clapping.
